name: niara-register-indexer
description: Long-running worker that reads real events from niara-contracts-PMEs and RegistroAssinaturas on Sepolia (plus the extra EVM testnets) and from the niara-register-solana and niara-pmes-solana programs on Solana devnet, plus the v2 registry/receipts and transferable records, and writes them to the Niara-Register Postgres.

scripts.test: tsx test/backlog.test.ts && tsx test/solana.test.ts && tsx test/evm-signatures.test.ts && tsx test/pmes-solana.test.ts && tsx test/v2.test.ts
